basis: Manual reading of all 22 distinct assay descriptions behind the 36 protein-assigned records. Descriptions are ChEMBL source text, not independently verified experimental methods.
default_action: Keep as contextual evidence; do not pool with baseline in-vitro potency or upgrade a biological evidence tier.

CHEMBL1785997.reason: Description explicitly identifies human H1 signalling in SK-N-SH cells. Organism-format label conflicts with that description; verify publication methods before reclassification.

CHEMBL1794333.reason: Hsp90 counterscreen in a microorganism system; mapped homologue does not turn a growth/readout assay into direct human Hsp90 activity.

CHEMBL1794470.reason: Antimalarial Hsp90-labelled screen in a microorganism system, with homologous assignment; retain the phenotypic context.

CHEMBL4604712.reason: Rat alpha4beta2 receptor occupancy related to brain concentration; keep brain matrix and occupancy endpoint distinct from binding affinity.

CHEMBL4604713.reason: Rat alpha4beta2 receptor occupancy related to plasma concentration; not interchangeable with the paired brain-concentration endpoint.

CHEMBL4810415.reason: Mouse tumour polyp response versus plasma exposure; does not isolate a COX2 biochemical inhibitory constant.

CHEMBL4810416.reason: Mouse tumour polyp response versus ileum exposure; keep tissue and phenotype explicit.

CHEMBL5223873.reason: Rat 5HT4 occupancy versus brain concentration in ng/g; tissue mass denominator requires additional assumptions for molarity.

CHEMBL5223874.reason: Rat 5HT4 occupancy versus plasma mass concentration; preserve exposure and measured chemical form.

CHEMBL641373.reason: Alpha2-mediated vasoconstriction in pithed rats; physiological endpoint with homologous family assignment.

CHEMBL648491.reason: Blood-pressure response in rats at a stated dose; description and IC50 nM field require methods review.

CHEMBL675844.reason: Spiperone displacement is described at a 10 mg/kg dose; inspect methods before treating the standard nM number as comparable in-vitro affinity.

CHEMBL687924.reason: Description says in vivo but identifies ERalpha/ERbeta co-expressed in HEK293 cells; family-level cell assay is plausible, pending original methods.

CHEMBL697020.reason: Description says in vivo and gel-filtered human platelets; platelet aggregation cannot be assumed to be direct receptor binding.

CHEMBL702340.reason: Human platelet serotonin uptake, labelled in vivo with homologous assignment. Preserve functional context and resolve metadata before reassignment.

CHEMBL767695.reason: Lactate oxidation attributed to pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase inhibition; retains downstream metabolic response and family-level assignment.

CHEMBL782725.reason: Oral progestational response in a uterine model is a dose endpoint, not a molar protein affinity.

CHEMBL785239.reason: Rat dopamine uptake description does not establish preparation or exposure basis; no automatic conversion to in-vitro transporter potency.

CHEMBL785240.reason: Rat serotonin uptake description is incomplete and the assignment homologous; inspect methods before pooling.

CHEMBL795984.reason: Alpha1-mediated vasoconstriction in pithed rats; preserve family and physiological endpoint.

CHEMBL795986.reason: Alpha2-mediated vasoconstriction in pithed rats; preserve family and physiological endpoint.

CHEMBL819251.reason: Tubulin polymerization at 30 C sounds biochemical but the preparation is unspecified; verify methods and homologous group assignment.
